storeInfo.name: Pizza Time
storeInfo.tagline: The Best Pizza Place in CT with Fresh Ingredients and Halal Meats / ¡La mejor pizzería de CT con ingredientes frescos y carnes Halal!

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio de entrega rápida disponible en Wethersfield, East Hartford y Windsor Locks.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Fast delivery service available in Wethersfield, East Hartford, and Windsor Locks.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas jugosas sazonadas y doradas a la perfección, servidas con salsa ranch o bleu cheese.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy, crispy seasoned chicken wings fried to perfection, served with your choice of ranch or bleu cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Bastones de queso mozzarella empanizados y fritos, acompañados de salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Battered and fried mozzarella cheese sticks served with warm homemade marinara dipping sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Pan crujiente untado con mantequilla de ajo fresco y cubierto con abundante queso mozzarella derretido.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy crust brushed with fresh garlic butter and topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Nuestra masa crujiente insignia cubierta con salsa de tomate especial y 100% auténtico queso mozzarella.
products.descriptionEn: Our signature crispy crust topped with rich signature tomato sauce and 100% authentic mozzarella cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Una obra maestra cargada con carnes Halal seleccionadas, champiñones frescos, pimientos y cebollas.
products.descriptionEn: A loaded masterpiece featuring selected Halal meats, fresh mushrooms, bell peppers, and onions.

products.descriptionEs: Para los verdaderos amantes de la carne: pepperoni Halal, salchicha, carne molida y tocino crujiente.
products.descriptionEn: For true meat enthusiasts: Halal pepperoni, sausage, ground beef, and crispy bacon topping.

products.nameEs: Calzone Relleno de Queso y Pollo
products.descriptionEs: Masa dorada al horno rellena con pollo Halal tierno, ricotta cremosa y abundante mozzarella.
products.descriptionEn: Golden oven-baked dough stuffed with tender Halal chicken, creamy ricotta, and lots of mozzarella.

products.nameEs: Submarino de Pollo a la Parmesana
products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada con salsa marinara y queso fundido en pan sub recién horneado.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded chicken cutlet topped with marinara sauce and melted cheese on freshly baked sub roll.

products.nameEs: Ensalada César con Pollo a la Parrilla
products.descriptionEs: Lechuga romana crujiente, crutones dorados, queso parmesano y tiras de pollo Halal a la parrilla.
products.descriptionEn: Crisp romaine lettuce, crunchy croutons, parmesan cheese, and grilled Halal chicken strips.

products.descriptionEs: Variedad de refrescos bien fríos (Coca-Cola, Sprite, Ginger Ale, etc.).
products.descriptionEn: Selection of ice-cold sodas including Coke, Sprite, Ginger Ale, and regional favorites.

products.descriptionEs: Té helado recién preparado con un toque perfecto de dulzura y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Freshly brewed iced tea prepared daily with a perfect touch of sweetness and lemon.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer Halal meats on your menu?
faqs.aEs: ¡Sí! Todas nuestras carnes son 100% Halal para garantizar la mejor calidad y satisfacción a nuestros clientes.
faqs.aEn: Yes! All our meats are 100% Halal to ensure the best quality and satisfaction for our customers.

faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos servicio de entrega rápida en Wethersfield, East Hartford, Windsor Locks y áreas circundantes.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer fast delivery service in Wethersfield, East Hartford, Windsor Locks, and surrounding areas.

faqs.aEs: Estamos ubicados en 152 Silas Deane Highway, Wethersfield, CT, con sucursales adicionales en East Hartford y Windsor Locks.
faqs.aEn: We are located at 152 Silas Deane Highway, Wethersfield, CT, with additional locations in East Hartford and Windsor Locks.
